extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, representatives, and EPO examiners
extracted.subtask_description: Index/notice page for the European Patent Office 'Guidelines for Examination' April 2010 edition describing amendments to examination practice and the Guideline sections affected. Intended to tell practitioners and examiners which Rules/topics have been updated and where to find the guidance in the Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voluntary division — events for period calculation (A-IV, 1.1.1.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: A-IV, 1.1.1.2 has been modified in order to clarify that the list of events from which the period for voluntary division is calculated is exclusive. In particular, a communication under Rule 161 EPC issued by the examining division does not qualify as the 'Examining Division's first communication' within the meaning of Rule 36(1)(a) EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies which events count when calculating the period for filing a voluntary divisional application; specifically excludes a communication under Rule 161 EPC from qualifying as the Examining Division's first communication for Rule 36(1)(a). See A-IV,1.1.1.2 for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Divisional applications (Rule 36)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to bring the Guidelines into line with Rule 36 (Divisional applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: A-III, 14; A-IV, 1 to 1.3.3; A-VIII, 1.3; C-III, 7.10, 7.11.1 and 7.11.4. Practitioners should consult those sections for updated procedural and substantive guidance on divisional filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications containing a plurality of independent claims (Rule 62a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments in relation to Rule 62a concerning applications containing a plurality of independent claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: B-III, 3.7, 3.10 and 3.11; B-IV, 2.1; B-VIII, 4 and 5; B-X, 3.1 and 8; B-XII, 7; C-III, 3.3; C-VI, 4.7, 5.2, 5.6 and 8.2. See these sections for limits/requirements and exam practice on multiple independent claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incomplete search (Rule 63)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to align the Guidelines with Rule 63 on incomplete search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: B-IV, 1.3; B-VIII, 3 and 5; C-II, 4.9; C-III, 4.1, 5 and 6.3; C-IV, 2.2 and 4.1; C-VI, 4.7, 5.2, 5.6 and 8.2. Consult these parts for practice on when and how a search is considered incomplete.

rubrics_metrics.name: European search report where the invention lacks unity (Rule 64)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance updated concerning Rule 64 on European search reports when the invention lacks unity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passage: B-VII, 1.2. See B-VII,1.2 for the EPO practice on unity objections and how they are reflected in the search report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information about publication (Rule 69)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to Guidelines relating to Rule 69 concerning information about publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passage: A-VI, 2.1. See A-VI,2.1 for publication-related procedures and notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response to the extended European search report (Rule 70a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance revised concerning Rule 70a — responses to the extended European search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: A-V, 2.1; A-VI, 2.1, 2.4, 2.5 and 3; B-XII, 1.2, 3.3, 3.9 and 9; C-III, 6.3, 7.10; C-IV, 2.2 and 4.1; C-VI, 1.1, 1.1.1, 3.2, 3.4 and 3.5; E-IX, 5.4 and 5.7. These sections explain how applicants should respond and the procedural consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further processing (Rule 135)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: A-III, 14; A-IV, 1.1.1.5; E-VIII, 2.1. Consult these for the conditions and procedural steps to request further processing after failure to meet time limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of the European patent application (Rule 137)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance updated in relation to Rule 137 on amendment of the European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: B-XII, 2, 2.2 and 9; C-VI, 2.1, 3.1 to 3.3, 3.5.1, 4.1, 4.7, 4.9, 5.2, 5.6, 5.7, 9.1.4 and 14.4. These sections cover when and how applications may be amended during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment after entry into the European phase (Rule 161)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments concerning Rule 161 — amendment of the application after entry into the European phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: A-VI, 2.4; A-VII, 7; C-III, 7.11; C-VI, 3.5.1 and 9.4; E-IX, 4a, 5.1 and 6.3.3. See these for limits and procedures for amendments after entry into the European phase (PCT national phase matters, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step — chapter C-IV,11 amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments were made to chapter C-IV, 11 concerning inventive step, in which the range of board of appeal decisions cited should be particularly noted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review C-IV,11 for updated guidance on assessing inventive step and the Board of Appeal decisions that inform current exam practice; the passage highlights that the cited case law range has been revised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic filing of documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guidance on electronic filing of documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: A-II, 1.3, 3.1; A-IV, 1.3.1; A-IX, 3.2; E-IX, 2. Consult these sections for rules, formats, and procedures for electronic filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of priority documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guidance on filing of priority documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: A-II, 5.4.3; A-III, 6.7; A-VII, 3.5; C-V, 3.3. See these sections for timing, certified copy requirements and related procedures for priority documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary European search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance updated with regard to the supplementary European search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: A-XI, 9.3.1; B-II, 4.3. See these for when a supplementary search is performed and how its results are handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications on the internet (what counts as prior art/publication)
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guidance on publications on the internet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passages: B-III, 2.5; B-IV, 2.3; C-IV, 6.2; D-V, 3.1.3. These sections address how internet disclosures are treated for novelty, prior art and evidence of publication date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postponement of oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance updated concerning postponement of oral proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant updated Guideline passage: E-III, 7. See E-III,7 for rules and conditions under which oral proceedings may be postponed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines not fully revised — follow notices/board decisions where applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: The Guidelines have not been fully revised. In some instances several passages do not completely reflect current examination practice. Recent publications or decisions that appeared subsequently could no longer be taken into account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where the Guidelines are out of date or inconsistent, practitioners should consult the cited notices (for example the notice dated 14 September 2009) and relevant Board of Appeal decisions. The April 2010 edition is the only valid official version as from 1 April 2010, but be aware of outstanding passages to be revised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments made in light of Board of Appeal decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: A number of amendments were made in the light of decisions of the Enlarged Board of Appeal and the other boards of appeal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the listed Guideline passages for details: C-III, 3.3, 4.2, 4.12, 4.16, 4.20 and 7.1; C-IV, 2.3.5, 4.1, 4.4, 4.8.1 and 5.4; C.VI, 5.2, 5.3.2 and 9.1.4; D-I, 4; D-V, 6.2; E-III, 7, 8.5 and 8.6; E-VI, 2 and E-X, 1.2. Practitioners should consult those sections for Board-influenced practice and reasoning.
